name: pukial
description: Pukial skills for Claude Code, one plugin across domains: deckwright turns an idea into a slide deck (binding spec, HTML drafts on a design system, native editable PPTX or printable HTML deck, QA loop); ship-check is the Flutter architecture gate (review -> triage -> fix -> recommend); new-app scaffolds a com.pukial Flutter app from flutter-pukial-starter; aso-appstore-screenshots produces conversion-focused App Store and Google Play screenshot decks; app-pilot drives iOS/Android apps for fast QA flows and screenshots (Jev + agent-device, Claude on handoffs); ci-github-actions keeps GitHub Actions CI within the account's minutes (diagnosis, rules guarded by tests, emergency playbook, isolated self-hosted runner); find-skills searches the open skills ecosystem and recommends skills only after a security review (skills.sh audits plus a read of the SKILL.md), never installing without approval.
